$comment: The venue register: how a calendar's free-text location becomes a named place with coordinates and — when the place has a page — the path of that page: a place page for a park, plaza or place in a park, else the address page of the parcel the venue is. fetch.py matches an event's location string against each key and each `match` entry (normalized: lowercase, alphanumeric-only, substring), longest matcher first. `path` is set only where the venue IS the page's place or parcel — an event at a spot with no page still gets a dot and a listing, just no panel and no link. `lat`/`lng` are the venue pin; set both, and say in `note` where they came from, so a coordinate here is a cited fact like any other.

sunset dunes.name: Sunset Dunes
sunset dunes.note: The Sunset Dunes place page — the park is the former Upper Great Highway, mostly unparceled right of way. The venue pin stays the OSM centroid; per-event coordinates from sunsetdunes.org override it.

alemany farm.name: Alemany Farm
alemany farm.note: Nature in the City's own event pin for the farm; Nominatim puts '700 Alemany Boulevard' at 37.7331,-122.4197 — same footprint. No EAS address on Alemany itself, but parcels/acdm-wktn puts the farm inside parcel 5801002, the 95 Justin Drive page.

united nations plaza.name: United Nations Plaza
united nations plaza.note: The UN Plaza place page (Rec & Park property on parcels 0351039–0351049). Events here are on the plaza itself, not in the 10–50 United Nations Plaza building on parcel 0351050. Coordinates are the place page's own.

city hall.name: City Hall
city hall.note: EAS resolves '1 Dr Carlton B Goodlett Place' to parcel 0787001 — the City Hall page. RecPark's 'City Hall Room 416 - 1 Dr. Carlton B. Goodlett Place' matches on 'city hall'.

randall museum.name: Randall Museum
randall museum.note: EAS resolves '199 Museum Way' to parcel 2615002 — the Randall Museum page. Coordinates are the page's own.

golden gate bandshell.name: Golden Gate Bandshell
golden gate bandshell.note: The Bandshell is the Spreckels Temple of Music (78 Music Concourse Drive), a place page in Golden Gate Park; Illuminate's LOCATION gives the Hagiwara Tea Garden Drive address beside it. Coordinates from Nominatim for the Bandshell.

mclaren lodge.name: McLaren Lodge
mclaren lodge.note: McLaren Lodge, 501 Stanyan Street — its own place page in Golden Gate Park. Coordinates from Nominatim.

hagiwara tea garden.name: Golden Gate Bandshell
hagiwara tea garden.note: The Bandshell is the Spreckels Temple of Music (78 Music Concourse Drive), a place page in Golden Gate Park; Illuminate's LOCATION gives the Hagiwara Tea Garden Drive address beside it. Coordinates from Nominatim for the Bandshell.

147 fulton.name: Fulton Street Plaza
147 fulton.note: Illuminate's own event page links this exact pin for '147 Fulton St' — Fulton Plaza, the block of Fulton Street between Hyde and Larkin, between the Main Library and the Asian Art Museum. It is public right of way, so it has no page: EAS has no 147 Fulton St (3mea-di5p: street_name='FULTON', nothing between 35 and 321), parcels/acdm-wktn intersects nothing at the pin while the points either side hit 0354001 (the Library) and 0353001 (the Asian Art Museum), and the Rec & Park properties dataset (gtr9-ntp6) has no property there. Checked 2026-09-26.

east meadow.name: 14th Avenue East Meadow, Golden Gate Park
east meadow.note: No place page for the meadow itself; it lies on parcel 1700001, Golden Gate Park's one parcel, the 6101 Fulton Street page. Coordinates from Nominatim for the East Meadow at 14th Avenue.

union square.name: Union Square
union square.note: The Union Square place page (Rec & Park property on parcel 0308001, the 333 Post Street parcel page). Coordinates are the place page's own.

sigmund stern grove.name: Sigmund Stern Grove
sigmund stern grove.note: The Sigmund Stern Recreation Grove place page (parcel 2488001). Coordinates are the place page's own.

civic center plaza.name: Civic Center Plaza
civic center plaza.note: OpenStreetMap centroid (nominatim 'Civic Center Plaza'), checked 2026-09. The plaza is parcel 0788001 — documented at 355 McAllister Street, one of its addresses.

rochambeau playground.name: Rochambeau Playground
rochambeau playground.note: The Rochambeau Playground place page (parcel 1384006). Coordinates are the place page's own.

mcateer campus.name: McAteer Campus
mcateer campus.note: The campus is parcel 7560003 — the 555 Portola Drive page. Coordinates are the event listing's own pin.

palou phelps.name: Palou Phelps Mini Park
palou phelps.note: The Palou & Phelps Park place page (parcels 5328xxx, 5329001). Coordinates are the place page's own.

adah's stairway.name: Adah's Stairway
adah's stairway.note: A stairway in the public right of way — parcels/acdm-wktn finds no parcel at the pin, so the venue lists and draws a dot but links no page.

moraga tiled steps.name: Moraga Tiled Steps
moraga tiled steps.note: The 16th Avenue Tiled Steps at Moraga — a stairway in the public right of way with no parcel (parcels/acdm-wktn), so no page path. Coordinates are the event listing's own pin.

698 connecticut.name: 698 Connecticut Street
698 connecticut.note: EAS resolves '698 Connecticut St' to this parcel point. RecPark lists block parties by street address; the event is the block, not a parcel the site documents, so no page path.

mission st and avalon.name: Mission Street & Avalon Avenue
mission st and avalon.note: Sunday Streets intersection in the Excelsior; no reliable coordinate source found yet — events here list on /events but draw no map dot.

balboa park.name: Balboa Park
balboa park.note: The Balboa Park place page (parcel 3179011). Coordinates are the place page's own.
